field_expectations.access: Selector R/W; bit31 BROWN_OUT_DET RO; bit29 CNT_CLR WO; no W1C field in this pinned word
field_expectations.write_scope: One explicit masked RMW of the full register. Before/after logged if later run; no guarantee other physical effects/bits are unchanged. Refuse the write when the read WO bit29 is1, avoiding replay of an observed1 strobe; a WO read is not a state/safety proof.

startup_interference.optional_ISR: Clears interrupt, possibly invokes callback, stops other core, sets BROWNOUT hint and calls esp_rom_software_reset_system; not a polarity witness
startup_interference.non_ISR_init: brownout_hal_config selects enum SYSTEM and writes threshold/reset/other fields; enum values are software intent, not authority resolving conflicting TRM
startup_interference.probe_choice: Exclude SDK brownout init/ISR via config; write only selector after reporting raw context. No threshold, arming, alternate mode or stimulus. not_armed_by_this_probe does NOT mean ROM/hardware disarmed.
startup_interference.UART_header_disagreement: Pinned efuse_reg.h comment mentions GPIO8; TRM1.8 says GPIO46. Only raw already-fixed00/11 is eligible in future probe; no comment chosen as hardware authority, no fuse writes.

artifact_expectations.generated_effects: Actual noinline function disassembly/preprocessed source and literal/address trace; compile flags/source and physical effects kept distinct
artifact_expectations.unsigned_public_only: No secure boot/flash encryption/signing key generation/auto-provision or hardware operation; generated configs checked
artifact_expectations.binary_equivalence: Not claimed; differing build paths/metadata and selector effects are recorded
